name: Konrad Grubenmann — burial in March 1787, Teufen, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Switzerland
researcher_question: When and where was Konrad Grubenmann, born 21 August 1698 in Teufen, Appenzell, who married Barbara Oberteufer in 1724, buried?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 26, hint-samples.csv row 882, flags adds_spouse/adds_burial, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-16 (#3346): true match. The 17 Mar 1787 burial of Conrad Grubenmann aged 88, entered in both the Teufen (ark:/61903/1:1:6FZ1-148K) and Stein (ark:/61903/1:1:6F88-WZBR) registers, is KP47-72Q (baptized 21 Aug 1698 Teufen, ark:/61903/1:1:6FZK-GBNL); either place is accepted. Decided on the indexes alone, so image_basis is off. The wife named in the entries stays unproven.
